claims: The Michigan Wolverines won the 2026 NCAA men’s basketball national championship.
The Michigan Wolverines defeated UConn 69-63 on April 6, 2026, in Indianapolis.
The win marks the Michigan Wolverines' first title since 1989.
Elliot Cadeau was the tournament Most Outstanding Player.
Dusty May was Michigan's head coach.
Final score of the 2026 championship was Michigan 69, UConn 63.
Elliot Cadeau scored 19 points in the final.
The Wolverines held UConn to 30.9% shooting.
Michigan scored 36 points in the paint.
UConn scored 22 points in the paint.
This victory gives the Big Ten conference champions in football (Indiana), women's basketball (UCLA), and men's basketball (Michigan) in the same season for the first time.
Dusty May joined the Michigan program in 2024
